content: {"reasoning":"This CPT requires prior authorization, which is missing, and the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Submitting records does not cure the authorization gap, and a medical-necessity appeal requires a denial that is not yet present. The remaining deductible alone does not establish patient liability for an unauthorized service, so no available automated action can properly progress this claim; specialist review is warranted.","action":"escalate"}
